name: Grow Every Bite 🍔
desc:
🍔 Grow Every Bite 🍔
Can you become the biggest eater in the world?!

Welcome to Grow Every Bite, the ultimate eating simulator where every bite makes you BIGGER, HEAVIER, and STRONGER!

🍕 Each bite = more weight
💥Flex your size
🔁 Jump over higher walls and get more wins!
🌍 Compete on the leaderboards to become the ultimate heavyweight!

Whether you're here to eat, grow, or just roll over your friends — this is your food-fueled path to greatness.
So grab your burger and LET’S GET CHUNKY! 😋
